integrity: The fixed graph, analytic proof and two standalone exhaustive verifiers are embedded with exact byte counts and digests in the private evidence envelope. Computational claims are finite and fully enumerated.
scientific_limitations: One eighteen-vertex graph; no generalization to all cubic or distance-regular graphs. Full historic priority is not certified; related early closed-neighborhood algebra and the Eulerian condition are acknowledged as prior art.
title: Three-wise independent odd domination and frozen five-sets of the Pappus graph
